sources.snippet: Therefore, in this study, the optimal input image conditions were investigated for the prediction of rice yield using a CNN based on UAV aerial images collected after the mid-ripening stage. An attempt was made to provide a rationale for the results by visualizing the region of interest in the CNN model.

sources.title: srinivas119/grainpalette---a-deep-learning-odyssey-in-rice-type ...
sources.snippet: GrainPalette is a deep learning-based system designed to classify five distinct varieties of rice using image recognition. The project encompasses the entire machine learning lifecycle, from dataset preparation and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) training in a research environment to the deployment of a functional web application for real-time inference.
